preconditions.description: The number of characters n is between 3 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of known relationships m is between 0 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b and c in (0, 1) for a, b, c in relationships)
preconditions.description: Each relationship tuple (a, b, c) has valid character indices distinct from each other and c is either 0 (hate) or 1 (love).
The number of relationship lines matches m.

preconditions.expression: len({(min(a, b), max(a, b)) for a, b, c in relationships}) == m
preconditions.description: No pair of characters is described more than once.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer modulo 1,000,000,007.

The output equals the number of ways to assign love/hate to all unknown pairs such that every triangle of three characters has either exactly one love pair or three love pairs, consistent with the given known relationships.
